patch_description: Replace the purely greedy single-point hill climb with a batched active-set repair phase. Heilbronn layouts are controlled by a small set of nearly minimum determinant constraints, so moving only one point at a time is often unable to escape coupled local optima. The new refinement repeatedly identifies the lowest-area triples, perturbs all points participating in those constraints jointly, and evaluates a vectorized batch of repair candidates. A small temporary lower-tail acceptance allowance lets the search traverse flat nonsmooth regions, while `elite` always preserves the best strict minimum-area arrangement encountered for the returned result.
